elements.text: Silent prints of the inland sea, 1998 to 2024
No experience needed. Cushions are provided, tea is served after.
A walk of nine kilometres, from the valley station to the shrine at the top.
Whisked at the table, thick or thin.
Soft rice cake, red bean, strawberry.
Two pancakes, a thick spoon of an.
Cold jelly of azuki, cut in squares.
Made each morning, gone when gone

The space between things.
A studio profile, 2026.
We take things out until it stops working, then put one back.
The margin belongs to the reader.
Each drawing gets one colour, picked by hand.
We sit with the people who will use it.
Sunset to ten, on the roof of the old bathhouse. Rice dumplings and warm sake.
